name: ecosmart-mobile-monorepo
description: Ecossistema mobile para descarte sustentável de resíduos e logística reversa

scripts.test:all: node scripts/sync-shared.js && cd frontend/ecosmart-cidadao && npm test && cd ../ecosmart-coletor && npm test && cd ../ecosmart-admin && npm test
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/sync-shared.js && cd frontend/ecosmart-cidadao && npm run test:coverage && cd ../ecosmart-coletor && npm run test:coverage && cd ../ecosmart-admin && npm run test:coverage
scripts.typecheck:all: cd frontend/ecosmart-cidadao && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../ecosmart-coletor && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../ecosmart-admin && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.start:cidadao: node scripts/sync-shared.js && node scripts/ensure-server.js && cd frontend/ecosmart-cidadao && npx expo start --port 8081
scripts.start:coletor: node scripts/sync-shared.js && node scripts/ensure-server.js && cd frontend/ecosmart-coletor && npx expo start --port 8082
scripts.start:admin: node scripts/sync-shared.js && node scripts/ensure-server.js && cd frontend/ecosmart-admin && npx expo start --port 8083

author: EcoSmart Mobile Team
